Document settings part returns None instead of SettingsPart instance

#### Description

When accessing the `_settings_part` property on a DocumentPart instance, it returns `None` instead of the expected SettingsPart object. This breaks functionality that depends on document settings.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx.parts.document import DocumentPart

# Create a document part instance
document_part = DocumentPart(None, None, None, None)

# Try to access the settings part
settings_part = document_part._settings_part

print(f"Expected: SettingsPart instance")
print(f"Actual: {settings_part}")
print(f"Type: {type(settings_part)}")
```

The above code should return a SettingsPart instance but instead returns `None`, which causes issues when trying to work with document settings.
</issue>
